subject: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds - Starlight Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@starlight.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — budget/volume check (Starlight Systems)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and two asks so we can get a formal quote over to procurement: 

Recap from our side:
- Primary use case: customer support triage + multi-turn summarization for in-app agent assist.
- Expected initial traffic: pilot with a subset of customers (roughly 30–50M tokens/month).
- Ramp profile: 3–6 months to broader rollout, forecast 150–250M tokens/month if all good.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly spend band you have in mind for the pilot (rough $/month)?
2) Any procurement thresholds we should plan for (PO minimums, approval levels, payment terms)?

I've attached our pricing sheet for reference (pricing-sheet-redwood-2027.xlsx) and a one-page outline of the pilot SOW. If you can share a rough budget band today/this week we can align on the most cost-efficient configuration & propose a target $/1M tokens for the pilot.

Next steps from me: I can prepare a short quote + SOW and share via DocuSign once we confirm budget + procurement path.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@starlight.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — budget/volume check (Starlight Systems)

Hi Marissa —

Great to connect. Quick answers below to help you size the quote: 

- Pilot expected token volume: ~30–50M tokens/month.
- If pilot goes well, we expect to ramp toward ~200M tokens/month over 3–6 months.
- Target monthly budget for pilot: roughly $12k–$20k / month (this is the budget owner estimate for the pilot cohort).
- Procurement thresholds: our procurement team flags any vendor spend above $25k for additional review. PO typically required for anything above $5k. Standard payment terms we get are net-60 after invoice; CFO will confirm.

On the unit economics side, the budget owner asked for a target around $400–$650 per 1M tokens for the pilot (they want to see options at different perf/cost points).

Procurement contact (looping in procurement alias separately if needed): procurement@starlight.com

Let me know if you'd like a target quote at $400/1M, $550/1M, and a recommended configuration (e.g., quantized model + caching) — happy to review.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson | Dir. Product — Starlight Systems
alex.johnson@starlight.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@starlight.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — budget/volume check (Starlight Systems)

Perfect — this is super helpful, thanks Alex.

Plan:
- I'll put together three short quote options for the pilot (30–50M tokens/month):
  1) Cost-optimized: $400 / 1M tokens — quantized model, aggressive batching & 24-48ms p50 latency target.
  2) Balanced: $550 / 1M tokens — mixed precision, KV-prefix caching, p50 latency ~20–30ms.
  3) Performance: $800 / 1M tokens — higher-throughput instance, lower latency and higher QoE.

- I'll also include an estimated monthly $ spend for each tier based on 30M and 50M token scenarios.
- I'll attach a preliminary SOW and the vendor security pack for procurement to review (SOW-draft-starlight-20270410.pdf, vendor-security-pack.zip).

Dylan/Rishi — FYI on procurement thresholds Alex mentioned (PO > $5k, review above $25k, net-60 common request). Rishi, can you confirm whether we need legal/enterprise approval for net-60 and if we can accept PO + invoice for the pilot?

Alex — I'll aim to get the three quotes + SOW to you tomorrow. If procurement wants the SOC 2 report or a redlined DPA, point them to the vendor pack in the attachment and I can escalate to security for anything additional.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Lydia Park <l.park@starlight.com>

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds - Starlight Systems

Hi Marissa —

Looping in on procurement requirements from the finance side. A few items to note so we can fast-track if the pilot fits our budget: 

- PO thresholds: PO required for all vendor engagements; anything above $25k requires VP procurement sign-off and vendor risk review.
- Payment terms: Our standard is net-60; Finance can accommodate net-30 for strategic partners but needs justification.
- Vendor security: Please provide SOC 2 Type II report and DPA; procurement will validate vendor security pack.
- Contracting: For pilots <$25k we can usually do a short form SOW + contractor agreement. Anything above will need our standard T&C review.

If Marissa can provide the three-tiered quote and the SOW, procurement@starlight.com will triage and get back within 3–5 business days.

Thanks —
Lydia Park
CFO | Starlight Systems
